linkedin:
How many times have you stood at a record fair, picked up an album, and wondered: 'Do I already own this?' Most collectors with 300+ items know the feeling—and the regret when you get home and realise you've bought a duplicate. Again.

It's not just about the money wasted. It's the friction of managing a large, beloved collection without letting it manage you. Cloud apps demand subscriptions and internet. Spreadsheets feel sterile. Your collection deserves better.

SeniorEase Library solves this with radical simplicity: scan your items once, keep your data private on your device, and never wonder again. €4.99. Once. No subscriptions, no accounts, no nonsense—just you and your collection, exactly as it should be.

If you're tired of the tech theatre around something this straightforward, we built this for you.

Learn more at seniorease.eu

#Collections #Simplicity #PrivacyFirst
